title: elaphoglossum angulatum
intro: Elaphoglossum angulatum, commonly known as the Angle-leaved Elaphoglossum, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Elaphoglossum angulatum include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-hypertensive effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, which make it a valuable resource for natural medicine.
